narrative: 你只有一小段时间，在这段时间里，普通的动作会因为太阳正在离开或到来而显得转瞬即逝。脸被侧光擦过，尘埃可见，天空依然明亮。
农场、道路和童年主题的外景戏都在等待这个时刻，因为它转瞬即逝。如果你需要三个小时的匹配镜头，或者你实际想要的是太阳落下之后的那段冷色时光，它就不是合适的工具。
在正午阳光上加一层橙色调色，并不等于黄金时刻（Golden Hour）。直射的傍晚阳光仍然是一种偏硬的光源；日落之后的包裹光是蓝调时刻（Blue Hour）或黄昏环境光。
how: 让场景朝向低角度的太阳。逆光很常见（暖色轮廓光、朝向摄影机方向的长长地面阴影）；正面或侧面的擦光同样可行。
由于大气的作用，硬度比正午更柔和，但阴影依然清晰。颜色是温暖的琥珀色，远低于正午的5600K。
在这个窗口期到来之前先排练好。提示词：Golden hour backlight on [Subject], warm amber raking sun, long shadows, horizontal flare.
when: 当一天正在结束或开始、太阳仍然挂在天上时使用：最后一次散步、一片田野、一道山脊。不要在正午的画面上套一个橙色LUT，然后说这是黄金时刻。
vs: 蓝调时刻是在日落之后或日出之前，环境是冷色的，没有硬朗的太阳直射主体。现场光（Available Light）是一种方法；黄金时刻是一种特定的现场光条件。
逆光是这种阳光的常见摆位。暖琥珀色调是一种可以模仿色相、却无法伪造出长阴影的调色手法。
examples_film: 《天堂之日》（Days of Heaven）耐心等待农场和草原上一天中的光线边缘。《生命之树》（The Tree of Life）使用低角度阳光下的童年段落。
《荒野猎人》（The Revenant）和《请以你的名字呼唤我》（Call Me by Your Name）都把傍晚或清晨的阳光当作一种需要排期的光源，而不是一个预设。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是拍成了蓝调时刻，或者一个橙色的正午调色。破绽是高角度的太阳，或者一片没有长阴影的冷色天空。
解决办法是降低太阳高度、让主光变暖，并投射出长长的阴影。

faq.q: 电影中的黄金时刻是什么？
faq.a: 日出后不久或日落前的低角度暖色阳光。阴影很长，颜色很暖，窗口期很短。

faq.q: 黄金时刻和蓝调时刻有什么区别？
faq.a: 黄金时刻的太阳仍然挂在地平线之上，是一个暖色方向性主光。蓝调时刻是太阳落下后的暮色，天空是冷色的，没有硬朗的阳光。

faq.q: 什么时候该用黄金时刻？
faq.a: 用于一段短暂的傍晚或清晨外景戏，可以接受长阴影和变化中的光线。如果无法按这个时间窗口排期，就不要用它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示黄金时刻？
faq.a: 指明贴近地平线的暖琥珀色斜射阳光，长长的阴影，常常作为逆光出现。不要是高角度太阳上的一层橙色调色。

narrative: You have a short window in which ordinary action looks transient because the sun is leaving or arriving. Faces rake, dust shows, and the sky still has brightness.

Farms, roads, and childhood exteriors wait on this hour because it will not hold. It is the wrong tool if you need three hours of matching coverage, or if you mean the cool time after the sun is down.
An orange grade on midday sun is not golden hour. Direct late sun is still a hard-ish source; post-sunset wrap is blue hour or dusk ambient.
how: Point the scene at the low sun. Backlight is common (warm rim, long ground shadows toward camera); front or side rake also works.
Hardness is softer than noon because of atmosphere, but shadows remain defined. Color is warm amber, well below midday 5600K.
Rehearse before the window. Prompt: Golden hour backlight on [Subject], warm amber raking sun, long shadows, horizontal flare.
when: Use it when the day is ending or beginning and the sun is still up, a last walk, a field, a ridge. Do not use an orange LUT on noon and call it this hour.
vs: Blue hour is after sunset or before sunrise, cool ambient, no hard sun disk lighting the subject. Available light is the method; golden hour is a specific available condition.
Backlight is a common placement of this sun. Warm amber is a grade that can fake the hue without the long shadows.
examples_film: Days of Heaven waited on farm and prairie edges of the day. The Tree of Life uses low-sun childhood passages.
The Revenant and Call Me by Your Name both treat late or early sun as a scheduled source, not a preset.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is blue hour or an orange midday grade. The tell is a high sun, or a cool sky with no long shadows.
Fix it by lowering the sun, warming the key, and throwing long shadows.

faq.q: What is golden hour in film?
faq.a: Low-angle warm sunlight shortly after sunrise or before sunset. Shadows are long, color is warm, and the window is short.
Golden hour still has the sun above the horizon as a warm directional key. Blue hour is twilight with the sun down, a cool sky, and no hard sunlight.

faq.q: When should I use golden hour?
faq.a: Use it for a brief late or early exterior that can accept long shadows and changing light. Skip it if you cannot schedule the window.

faq.q: How do I prompt golden hour for AI image or video?
faq.a: Specify warm amber raking sun just above the horizon, long shadows, often as backlight. Not an orange grade on a high sun.
